programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Project Street Regal has it's dated vinyl top removed and we add some goodies to the front of our Mustang Project Sydewinder
programme.sub-title: Adding an Air Splitter on a Mustang Cobra Foxbody

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Out of the shop and into the yard! We take a weekend to rebuild a 350ci small block Chevy V8 engine like you would at your home. We'll trade in our professional gear for tools you might have at your house to show you how to get the most out of your build.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.
programme.sub-title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: Dragonali's Duramax gets a lift pump to handle higher horsepower. And our '65 C10 Lo 'n Slo is back with the rebuilt 292 straight-six. It's fitted on the Engine Power dyno for some initial pulls.
programme.sub-title: Duramax Diesel Fuel Upgrades for High Performance

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Project Night shift is back in the shop! The guys install a rebuilt transfer case in our '93 Dodge Diesel Dually. They also plumb in our bigger turbo setup, showing you how to bead roll your tubing to make a secure fit. Plus, they'll show you the tools you'll need make your own brake lines.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc finish up the last few details on our '69 SeaFoam Camaro. Plus a mechanics fantasy land we head to California for the Matco Tools Expo to see what new products they have coming out.
programme.sub-title: '69 Camaro Gets a Fresh Interior Look with Overhauled Seats and Carpet

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: See if your top ten muscle car list matches ours as we count down our favorite American Muscle Cars.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Assembly on the 4.3L engine begins with a solid bottom end, including a set of forged pistons and a bigger cam shaft.
programme.sub-title: In-Depth Build Of An Old School Chevy 4.3L V6 Build Part 1

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The final touches are added to our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Truck project. Then we hit the open road and see our LOW-Fi lay frame for the first time. This is a MUST SEE show!
programme.sub-title: Low-Fi S-10: We Wrap Up and Lay Frame!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We upgrade our 280Z's suspension to give it better handling. We also take a look at what new products NISMO has designed and developed for customizing your Nissan project.
programme.sub-title: 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod Gets Improved Suspension

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We kick off a ground up build based around Summit's brand new, specially designed Small Block Chevy engine block. Featuring a large bore and stroke equaling 427ci, this robust platform will become the foundation for a high horsepower, pump gas, street dominator.

programme.title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live "Crushing It"
programme.desc: With Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live returning to the big screen, see our Designer Round Table and learn about the design process in making a toy monster truck. Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live gives you an under the hood look at the iconic cars that call the Hot Wheels garage home.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our split-bumper Camaro receives a hand-crafted exhaust, designed by one of Magnaflow's own.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our 1971 Chevy Caprice, Project Fat Stack, ROARS to life after almost a year of work. Tommy and Peyton give the nitty gritty on exhaust installation and finish the interior. Fat Stack turns heads in downtown Nashville to the delight of the Broadway crowd.
programme.sub-title: Fat Stack - Part 14: Clean, Mean, and Candy Green

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.
programme.sub-title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The EBC Fastback Mustang is transformed from an iconic fastback to a muscle packed stallion.
programme.sub-title: Dropping A Supercharged Coyote In The '70 RestoMod Mustang

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: After a year in the shop, the turbo powered 292 straight-six is broken in and hits the road and the track for a run down the 1/8th mile drag strip. Plus we rescue a Toyota Tundra in need of accessories.
programme.sub-title: Took Our '65 Fleetside Chevy C10 to the Dragstrip and It BROKE

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: All of the potential of a new '74 Bronco gets realized with serious engine power, dynamic paint, and a killer suspension, all coming together to make this a one-of-a-kind ride.
programme.sub-title: Our '74 Bronco Gets Some Coyote Power and a Classic Paint Job

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The guys down in Engine Power have finished beefing up our '69 Camaro' s engine with some high-performance parts, now we have to install it and upgrade the drive train so it can hold it's own with today's modern muscle.
programme.sub-title: Squeezing the Heartbeat Of Our '69 Camaro Between the Fenders

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our SPEC Mustang Project is back for final touches, as we get it ready to hit the track. After we finish our upgrades, we do just that and head to a Summit Racing Event and put it to the test.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Our Mustang Cobra project "Sydewinder" hits the track at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals! 600+Horsepower and set up for the track, the Foxbody beast is loose!
programme.sub-title: Mustang Sydewinder at the Mid America Ford and Shelby Nationals

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass crew invites a few friends out for a day on the trails. We put our Jeep JK to the test and flex it in the hills of East Tennessee.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass team prep the Willys cab for a hefty chassis, and give the undercarriage of their military ambulance a lift with some suspension upgrades.
programme.sub-title: Reviving the Mud Wagon's 600HP Monster to the Max

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: We bring a 96' Chevy Tahoe into the shop and show you what trouble areas to look for when buying a project. Then we teardown the front end and freshen up our suspension and steering components making our SUV roadworthy.
programme.sub-title: '96 Chevy Tahoe Gets Fresh Suspension & Steering

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our rolling dyno sled receives a fuel system, intercooler, and hand-built exhaust. Plus: take a visit inside Dustless Blasting's manufacturing facility.
programme.sub-title: Custom Cooling, Custom Exhaust, The Test Sled Build is On!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Interior Decorated - Tommy and Joel cut a rug and freshen up the rest of Fat Stack's interior to match the flashy exterior of their 1971 Chevy Caprice.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We show you all the trucks, from late models to classics, including BIGFOOT, and a drifting exhibition, that are on display to the public at the first annual Power Nationals event in Nashville.

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: We're getting the rear racing suspension installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Learn how the major components of a brake system are manufactured as the guys go to England and tour the EBC Brakes facilities.
programme.sub-title: A Tennessee Tom in King Arthur's Brake Factory

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Journey to the Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Seasons Of The Otter
programme.desc: One of the most loves animals, famed for its playful nature and incredible underwater agility. Yet most of the life of the otter goes unseen. Following the first year in the life of a young otter family, we'll reveal the secrets of the otter's world. Otter life is often a challenge, and especially so for a young family trying to make it through winter. Two pups were born last spring, and as they approach their first birthdays the time with their mother is coming to its end.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Cost of Progress
programme.desc: The natural world is in crisis. For years humanity has exploited the planet's resources, and the creatures that live here. Growth and innovation can be a marvelous thing, but at what cost to our one and only planet? When we continue to push ahead blindly, it's more often than not Mother Nature that pays the price. Now it is time for us to rally - to take heed and start to turn back the tide. It's time for us to recognize our part in this crisis and redress the balance of the cost of progress.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Lion - Africa's Super Power
programme.desc: The endless plains of East Africa is a paradise for lions. The most social of all cats, lions form prides that are unlike any other animals. Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers.

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Animals of Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Thanksgiving. A most treasured holiday, and not just in the USA; it continues to be celebrated across the world in many different guises. These traditions are all united by a celebration of the harvest and the generosity of the natural world. Many animals have weird and wonderful connections to the holidays. Turkeys are one of the most iconic characters, but deer, lobsters and even eagles are also part of the feast.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: Heroes of the Wild Frontiers
programme.desc: The Royal Bengal Tiger is in it's most primeval form here in the Sunderbans. `The tangled mangroves along the tributaries of the river Ganga are one of the most fearsome forests of the World. The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Easter The Start of Something Big
programme.desc: Easter, not just a chocolate feast loved by children. One of the biggest events in the religious calendar, celebrated by millions and steeped in customs and traditions. And for all its different meanings there are some key characters we associate with the holiday: chicks, bunnies and lambs have become integral to our celebrations. How have these animals become a part of Easter tradition? There are many twists and turns in the story, but without a doubt this is the start of something big!

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: January (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In episode two we take a look at Maui and Moloka'i. In the middle of the archipelago they form the heart of Hawaii. The second largest island of Hawai'i - Maui - is a true paradise for surfers. Archie Kalepa was one of the first big wave surfers and is still chasing the thrill today. The ukulele represents the sound of the islands like no other instrument. Eric Devine has been building the plucked string instrument for 20 years. In Kula he goes in search of the perfect wood.

programme.title: Nuts About Squirrels
programme.desc: Even in our most urban settings, pretty much all of us know squirrels. They can be divisive charac-ters; some people adore them, offering them food, while others see them as glorified rats. But we can all agree that these are speedy, quirky, and exceptional characters. They also go crazy for nuts. They've conquered most of the globe, from icy tundra to the hottest deserts, developing ingen-ious life skills along the way, from stashing nuts to fighting snakes.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Wildest Places: Australia
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The top of New Zealand's South Island is a landscape of two halves. To the West, one of the longest natural sandbars on the planet curves protectively around Golden Bay. To the East, mountains sink into the sea, their drowned river valleys forming the Marlborough Sounds. Turbulent currents connect them, both treacherous and full of riches.
programme.sub-title: Top of the South/ Te Tau Ihu

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Migrations - Herds on the Move
programme.desc: Whether driven by the search for food or the simple will to survive, great herd migrations are some of the most spectacular events of the natural world.

programme.title: The Enchanted Forest
programme.desc: To spend a day in the forest, from dawn to dusk, is to bathe in nature. There's enchantment at every turn. Throughout the day the cast of characters in the forest changes, from foraging bears to playing fox cubs, dashing hummingbirds and dancing butterflies. But it's as twilight descends, that the most enchanting side of the forest is revealed. Time to watch a firework display curtesy of fireflies. They are the real magicians of the enchanted forest.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Lying like a teardrop in the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka is an island that defies convention. Poised just six degrees above the equator, it's less than 75,000 km sq in size. But it has enough wildlife to rival a continent, and it's all down to its complicated climate and geography.

programme.title: March (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: Hidden Spain
programme.desc: Spain is found at the crossroads between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic, resulting in diverse landscapes, ancient cultures and magnificent wildlife.

programme.title: Lions Rule
programme.desc: The Lion, Africa's ultimate predator. An essay in power and agility, famed for the cut-throat gang and the killer instinct. Lions are known as the kings of the jungle yet their homeland is an open grassland rather than rainforest. In the African plains prey-rich real estate can be hard to come by, and lions work together to ensure no one claims their territory and usurps their crown.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts
programme.desc: Driven by surging hormones, every creature on the planet, big or small, will do whatever it takes to find and secure a mate. For some this will take the fight of their lives, while others must preen, prance and party their way to success. From one night stands and group sex to lifelong love and unbreakable bonds, when it comes to finding a mate the animal kingdom has it all. The need to breed manifests itself in all sorts of wonderful antics, displays and behaviours.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Wild Uruguay
programme.desc: Uruguay's biodiversity is surprisingly greater than one would expect. We will find out why as we embark on a journey through its ecosystems and landscapes to discover its fauna. Today we know that Uruguay is more than just the outermost edge of the Pampas, as the country holds a range of ecosystems. Within its borders, species of the Pampas come face to face with species of the Atlantic Forest, the Misiones rainforest, and the Chaco forest, giving rise to unexpected encounters.

programme.title: Coasts - Rolling with the Waves
programme.desc: We love our coasts, and so do animals! The corridor of water where the open ocean transitions into coastal habitat is known as the surf zone. The churning forces of the waves clashing with the land make these some of the most food-rich waters on Earth. Nutrients are both washed off the coast from rain and rivers, but also pushed up from the depths thanks to waves and currents.

programme.title: Christmas Oranges
programme.desc: Experience the journey of Rose, an orphan who teaches hope to all those around her in this poignant Christmas based on a classic holiday tale.

programme.title: Homeless For The Holidays
programme.desc: When an uncaring executive falls from the corporate ladder, he learns how difficult it can be to find work and compassion in today's economy. He eventually accepts a humiliating job, but with bills rapidly piling up, and not enough money to go around, he quickly discovers that, unless something changes soon, he'll lose everything by Christmas. Will family and faith be enough to bring joy when you're Homeless for The Holidays?

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.title: Christmas Grace
programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: The Messenger's Box
programme.desc: When high school student Jake Casper finds a small wooden box in the attic of his grandpa's antique store, his life is forever changed, especially when he discovers a secret compartment that appears to contain a nail used during Christ's crucifixion. Now, the more Jake learns of the power within the box and its purpose, the more obstacles he must overcome to get the box to a stranger before it's too late.

programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: Jennifer Miller, a self-centered teenager, learns the importance of giving during the Christmas season when her mother falls ill with cancer. While working at a homeless shelter, she meets unexpected friends who change her perspective.

programme.title: Finding Christmas
programme.desc: Mikey Finnegan, a 17-year-old from Philly, dreams of becoming a pro gamer. After a Christmas Eve attack leaves him in a coma, he travels back to Bethlehem. Guided by a Guardian Angel, he must find baby Jesus to return home.

programme.title: The Miracle Of The Cards
programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James returns to his former home city of Los Angeles, where he reconnects with old friends working in accessibility in the entertainment industry, enjoys Korean BBQ, street food, and hits the beach for a little surfing.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: After a surprise invite to visit the head of accessibility at Microsoft's headquarters in Seattle, James heads to Vancouver, known for its breathtaking natural beauty and self-proclaimed title of "most accessible city in the world."

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James sets out to discover what it's like to travel blind in the Big Apple, to see if someone like him can make it there.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London; he dives into the nation's crown cuisine of Indian food and learns a new sport, created by and for the visually impaired.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England; from ghost tours and hiking in Scotland, to football in Liverpool, to an epic thrill ride in Wales.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James and his older brother Colton head to Austin, Texas to sample BBQ from a blind pitmaster and live music from a blind musician; ashort road trip to Houston connects them with blind celebrity chef Christine Ha.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James and his sister Cassie visit Frankfurt and Mainz, enjoying beer and brats, and exploring Germany's infrastructure of support for the visually impaired; this culminates in a tour of the Dialogue Museum.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: James and his sister Cassie travel to Zurich and visit ETH Zurich, the MIT of Europe, where they try out prototypes of new technological solutions for accessibility; they venture to the top of a tall peak in Davos for an evening in an igloo.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: In Tokyo, a city of over 24 million, James tries not to get lost in the crowd as he attempts to conquer his fear of seafood, meets a blind breakdancer, and learns how the sighted and blind alike prepare for the city's next natural disaster.

programme.title: Blindspots
programme.desc: The bullet train takes James to Osaka and toward his ultimate goal: to climb Mount Fuji; outside the big cities, James searches for peace in Kyoto's temples; sacred traditions and a mountain covered in monkeys offer a new perspective on life.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Early in their history, humans realize that they can affect nature by controlling fire, making tools and taming wild animals; what they were not given by nature, they harnessed in other species.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: From the mysterious megaliths in prehistory to the first hot air balloons and the construction of the Giza pyramid complex, ancestors have always observed and experimented to gain a better understanding of their world.
programme.sub-title: Gravity: It All Falls Into Place!

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: A journey through the key events that have allowed people to better understand the world of microbe.
programme.sub-title: Viruses and Bacteria: Tiny but Tough

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: A journey through the key moments that enabled humanity to discover plastics.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Long-distance communication, moving stealthily through the dark without being detected, and observation from afar have all become commonplace; at any moment, one can know exactly where one is on the planet.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: The understanding of energy enables people to send rockets into space; learning what exactly is energy and where it comes from.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Running climate simulations on a global scale; learning to control rivers and protect against flooding.
programme.sub-title: Fluid Mechanics: A Source of Inspiration

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: The development of incredible technologies, from the infinitely small to the infinitely large; a journey through the key moments that allow humanity to discover quantum physics.
programme.sub-title: Quantum Physics: A Step Into Unknown

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Many natural phenomena are based on the laws of physics; forecasting the weather several days in advance; asking if it is possible to predict everything.
programme.sub-title: Chaos Theory: Small Causes, Great Effects

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Countless machines are used to perform hard work in one's daily life, with each of them obeying a specific program custom-written in a particular language.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: Handling numbers so large that all the books in the world would not be enough to contain them; societies are profoundly reliant on an increasingly complex equation.
programme.sub-title: Mathematics: How to Speak to Robots?

programme.desc: People just begin to understand what happens beneath their feet in the heart of the planet, to be better equipped to predict and prepare for tomorrow's volcanic eruptions or tsunamis.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: When water unleashes its rage upon the planet, it becomes the ultimate bringer of death; whether it's from rain washing over the ground, rivers bursting their banks, or failed efforts to stem the flow, flooding is as inevitable as it is unstoppable.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: Bridges and tunnels revolutionized transportation-but when they fail, tragedy follows. This episode explores the world's worst collapses and fires, including a tunnel blaze in the Alps so intense it fused 20 cars together. While bridge failures send vehicles plummeting into water or ground below, tunnel fires turn confined spaces into infernos. Why do these disasters happen, and what can be done to stop them? As we build bigger and faster, we also raise the stakes.

programme.desc: A Grindhouse classic! programme.title: Revenge of a Shaolin Master
programme.desc: A corrupt mayor robs a large cargo of food and money that's being sent to a famine area in eastern China. The Chief escort of the Cargo is then framed for the robbery and sentenced to death. His fiancée seeks the help of a constable to investigate the robbery and together they expose the heinous plot and bring the culprits to justice in an epic martial arts fight to the finish, choreographed by Yuen Woo Ping.

programme.title: Art of the Japanese Sword
programme.desc: The Japanese sword ... prized as much for its exceptional beauty as for its deadly cutting ability. It has endured for a thousand years as the pinnacle of Japanese culture. Now you can enter a world rarely seen by outsiders. To experience the true story of the Art of the Samurai Sword. A story told in the swordsmiths own words that separate the myth from the fact. Follow the swordsmiths dream of creating a masterpiece.

programme.title: Final Mission Final aka Who Knows About Me
programme.desc: Here is a place full of murder, terrorism and assassination. His obsession is to create the ultimate challenge...His final mission is to finalize...An ex-convict, Sung, is determined to go straight rather than fall back into the clutches of leading gang boss Lo. Hunted by the gang, who are trying to recover some incriminating photos, Sung seeks the help of an ex-model and a fighter so as expose the gang boss and his nefarious activities.

programme.title: Fatal Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A crazed martial artist who kills with his flying guillotine wreaks havoc on the martial world. The main character is a swordsman whose mother is ill, and to get the medicine, he must pass 3 tests, which gets him caught up in the guillotine affair.

programme.title: Duel with Samurai
programme.desc: An expert Samurai (Chen Hung Lieh) from Japan, travels to China to test out the Chinese Sword arts in a series of fierce duels he discovers what is mightier. Is it the Dragon sword or the Katana?

programme.title: Warriors of China
programme.desc: An exhilarating travelogue inside the middle kingdom to experience the major martial art styles of China. This once in a lifetime quest was to document Shaolin Temple Kungfu and Sanshou boxing, Wudangquan, Tai Chi Chuan, Baguazhang, Xingyiquan and Yiquan... from the external to the internal arts. Together for the first time in one movie are some of China's top kungfu masters. these are the Warriors of China!

programme.title: Offensive Shaolin Longfist aka Deadly Shaolin Longfist
programme.desc: Carrying a secret letter of Lord Kim, the great master Jin Sung-jin and his best disciple Kim Wun-do go to Jung-won region to get money and gold from the noble man Yeom. The evil Paeng Jang-rim gang finds this out and steals the letter. They secretly exhort the money and gold. Yeom is aware of this, so he sends Wang Tae-sa, a secret assassin, to Tae-bin where Paeng Jang-rim lives.

programme.title: Fists of Legends 2: Iron Bodyguards
programme.desc: After escaping death in Shanghai, Ching Wu Society member Chen Jan quietly roams China, teaching martial arts to his fellow patriots. He is contacted by the associates of Dr Sun Yat Sen, who ask him to help bring Dr Sun into China from Hong Kong. The Manchu regime, of course, has other ideas. As plans are being arranged, a Russian fighter asks Chan for a duel to see who is truly the best - East or West!

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: "The lone wolf is blamed for the murder of a young samurai, now he's caught in between a vengeful mother and a deceitful corrupt official."

programme.title: Warriors of China
programme.desc: An exhilarating travelogue inside the middle kingdom to experience the major martial art styles of China. programme.title: The Deadly Fists
programme.desc: A mountain girl Chie finds her father mortally injured by the roadside, and in his dying last breath he names a mysterious stranger, Yuan. She sets out in search to find Yuan, and decides to go to the Shaolin Master, who advises and instructs her to go and meet a rich Lord who might have knowledge of the killer's whereabouts. However, he too seeks Yuan, and fearing competition, he tries to kill her. Who is this stranger, that all are seeking to find him?

programme.title: Magnificent Wonderman from Shaolin
programme.desc: During the Mongolian invasion of China, a priest entrusts the safety of a Golden Buddha statue to a band of misfit martial artists. Si Leung, a dumb mute, learns of a plot to steal the statue, but is betrayed by the people close to him. He must practice the secret martial arts of Fire Fist day and night to take revenge for the priest's death and restore the glory of the Shaolin Temple.

programme.title: Duel at Forest aka Duel at the Forest
programme.desc: Pai Lung (Man Kong-Lung) returns home from a prison sentence for accidentally killing the father of his girlfriend Snow (Sally Chen). Upon arriving, he finds that Snow has gotten married to the town's gambling addict an all-around loser Chu Hu. The casino in town is being run by a Westerner (Robameice Deimikor) and his band of thugs that keep things running smoothly.

programme.title: 52 Masters
programme.desc: Sifu Sonny Mannon comes by to teach Will techniques in the ancient art of Chinese
programme.sub-title: 52 Masters: SHUAI JIAO CHINESE WRESTLING with Sonny Mannon

programme.title: Raging Masters Tiger Crane
programme.desc: Hwang Jang Lee plays the Silver Fox in this brilliant production from Korea. Li-Siu, a young Shaolin Monk finds the opportunity to practice his kung fu teachings. During his practice he stumbles onto the murder of the Abbot at the Shaolin Temple and the kidnapping of the elder monk Do-Lim. A string of pearls found in the hands of the murdered Abbot is the only clue that leads Li-Siu to the Silver-Fox, the murderer and sinister mastermind of a deadly plot to invade China.

programme.title: Duel with Samurai

programme.title: Snake Deadly Act
programme.desc: Kwok Chung is a righteous rich kid whose hobby is to fight and brawl. One encounter nearly gets him killed, but he's saved by Yueh (Fong Hak On), the Snake Fist Master. Yueh befriends and teaches Kwok the deadly art of the snake. Soon, Kwok realizes that his teacher has more in common with a snake than just techniques. He's being set up by his teacher, and his family is also targeted for murder! The treachery runs very deep, as Kwok and Yueh have a Snake Style showdown to end them all!

programme.title: Golden Showdown
programme.desc: You'll know them when you see them! Returning to his home town and finding it overrun with ruthless gangsters led by Mr Chore, Richard sets out to stop their nefarious activities. A bloody conflict ensues, and when Richard's father is killed in retaliation he finds out that the law is no better. But then his sister is killed and Richard finally snaps, taking on the gang single-handedly and loaded to the very last bullet.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub
programme.desc: Lord Retsudou ordered teams of assassins to kill Ogami. The lone wolf made new allies and now he must fight his way through this journey full of betrayals and deceits.

programme.title: Green Jade Statuette
programme.desc: A band of criminal's returns to a vice-filled village one year after their theft of a valuable family artifact, along with a talented fighter hired to recover the relic. Top-notch old-school shapes from the team that brought you "Eagles Claw".

programme.title: Sleeping Fist
programme.desc: Kam an undercover cop plans to report the crimes committed by Cho and his thugs. Beaten in a fight he is lucky Kid is nearby to rescue him and introduces him to Old Fox (Simon Yuen), who teaches them both Sleeping Fist Kung Fu.

programme.title: Dragon the Young Master
programme.desc: Pai Wu Lang returns to the village in search of the villain who killed his father. programme.title: Ninja vs Shaolin Guards aka Guards of Shaolin

After the Abbot of Shaolin is killed by their traitorous teacher a band of student monks embark on a mission to return the Golden Sutra to Tibet. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful female warrior - who aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains and weather challenges, all the while the students fight off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

programme.title: Master Killers

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: Remembering Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: As President Roosevelt said, the Japanese surprise attack on Pearl Harbor on the morning of December 7, 1941 was a day that would live in 'Infamy'. Aimed at the Pacific Fleet of the U.S.Navy, the attack damaged or destroyed twelve American warships and killed 2,403 American servicemen and 68 civilians.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: As the Second world War rages, watch how America builds up its air power even before getting dragged into the conflict. As early as 1939, President Roosevelt stepped up the production of military aircraft, leading to decisive victories by American forces.

programme.title: Smashing Down the Reich
programme.desc: This documentary evokes the destruction of the Nazi war machine with a particular emphasis on air power. The most significant events are recounted as the Normandy landings, the battle of Paris, the last German offensive with the historical siege of Bastogne and the landing on the island of Elba. Also shown are the bombing of German industrial centers, and the liberation of concentration camps.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This installment talks about the lessons learned, both military and diplomatic, about coalition warfare. It includes a reenactment of the Alamogordo atomic bomb test, as well as its use against Japan.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Allies keep supply lines open to China.
programme.sub-title: The War in the China-Burma-India Theatre

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: Created in 1945, this rare color documentary THE 6TH MARINE DIVISION ON OKINAWA film shows the massive battle for the island of Okinawa, focusing on the activities of the American 6th Marine.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this penultimate film of the series, '1944', the time had come for the beginning of the end of World War II. Chart the progress of the Allies regained ground throughout Italy, while the Russians pushed ever westwards towards Poland, forcing the Nazi occupiers to head for home. The Americans were also making good progress in the Pacific with strong counter offensives, steadily recovering ground.

programme.title: Hidden Side of World War II
programme.desc: This section takes a look behind the scenes at D-Day, revealing confidential decisions taken by the rulers, as well as the involvement of top-ranking officers and secret agents in the operations.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Thanks to the American landing in June 1944, the Allies were certain to end the war before Christmas. This optimism led them to make strategic mistakes, and sometimes to retreat in the face of the Wehrmacht's fierce resistance. When winter came, the enemy may have been weakened, it was far from being dead.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Death Army - Part II: Death and Decline

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: Battle of Midway to Victory in the Pacific
programme.desc: A rare color film from WWII on the battle for control of the Aleutian Islands in the Northern Pacific.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: As the Allies land in Normandy, Hitler unleashes Das Reich, the brutal Panzer division infamous for massacres in Ukraine and Belarus. With 15,000 men and 200 tanks, it marches north through France, crushing Resistance attacks and committing atrocities in Tulle and Oradour-sur-Glane, leaving a trail of terror and blood in its path.
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Death Army - Das Reich - Part One

programme.title: WWII War Diaries
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: Newsreel Film of the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: With fuel and supplies all but depleted, the Germans withdraw and end up back where they started. With the battle won, hard questions are asked as to how such a bitter and bloody battle could catch the Allies off-guard, and surviving servicemen from across the lines share thoughts and memories that embody the fighting spirit of the American armed forces.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The landings on the beaches of Normandy, the first step in the operation, codenamed Overlord enterprise by Dwight D. Eisenhower. The greatest amphibious invasion in history.

programme.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
programme.desc: Ranger Combat Training School, Fort Shafter, Territory of Hawaii.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers to 1945, a year filled with crucial events that shape the end of the war. The Yalta Conference, where Allied leaders discuss the post-war world, coincides with the final assaults on Germany. As Berlin falls and Hitler commits suicide, the Nazi regime finally collapses. The war in Europe is over, but the fight in the Pacific rages on.

programme.desc: A Japanese Fighter Pilot and an American airman remember the bombing of Japan in 1945, culminating in the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower and his aides map the Normandy invasion. German pictures show the extent of their coastal defenses. Tanks, guns, locomotives, and other military equipment is massed on the English beaches. Troops practice loading operations. Landing craft is tested in the English Channel. Pictures of practice landing and airborne operations are used to dramatize the actual invasion on June 6, 1944.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: Battle of Midway to Victory in the Pacific
programme.desc: A Japanese Airman and an American Seaman recount their memories of the attack on Okinawa and the role of the Kamikaze pilots.

programme.desc: The build up of the US Navy prior to its battle with Japan for supremacy in the Pacific.

programme.desc: A Japanese Lieutenant and a Philippine Corporal remember the invasion of the Philippines by the Japanese in WWII.

programme.title: Embedded 45' Shooting War in Germany
programme.desc: This first episode covers the last week of February to late March. When American troops started their final invasion of Nazi Germany in February 1945, U.S. Army cameramen were at their side. Over a thousand reels have been preserved; many of them untouched for decades. The cameramen covered many stories of victory and defeat, death and liberation. Faces of despair and joy, scenes of war and peace.

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: In a last effort at glory, having lost most of their best men in military actions, Japan employs suicide pilots - Kamikaze - men who willingly crash their planes into ships in order to destroy the American spirit. But the U.S. Navy and Marines are ready for them with their guns, and they fought heroically against the onslaught. And on Okinawa, Americans fight a major battle with the Japanese Army.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: The town of Hotten became very important during WWII as Hitler has ordered it held at all costs because of its key defensive location by the Siegfried Line. An infantry regiment and tanks attack but are stopped by heavy mortar fire. A small squad succeeds by using grenades and .45 submachine guns, allowing the tanks and infantry to take the town after a fierce fight. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: In April 1945, the Yamato, the largest battleship in history, left for Okinawa to destroy American warships and prevent their landing. Weighing 70,000 tonnes and armed with 150 guns, it faced the U.S. naval aviation, including aircraft carriers USS Essex and USS Yorktown. In a fierce battle, American pilots focused on one goal: sink the Yamato. This marked a turning point in WWII naval warfare.

programme.title: World War II: Battles Won & Lost
programme.desc: Through history, armies marched to face each other on favored ground and clashed to decide a campaign, a war, an empire. During WWII that changed: Kokoda Australian Campaign, Soviet Finnish war, Kasserine Pass, Burma, Convoy PQ17, Battle of Moscow.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The leaders of the Pacific are discussed: Chester M. Nimitz, Douglas MacArthur.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After a brutal day of relentless combat, the Allies secure a 50-mile bridgehead in Normandy. Now, American, British, and Canadian forces must push inland, capture a major supply port, and liberate Paris. Facing harsh terrain, supply shortages, and fierce German resistance, casualties soar into the hundreds of thousands in this costly battle for freedom.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Burma Road Campaign
programme.desc: Allied forces from all over the world combine to liberate Burma from the Japanese occupation in WWII.

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The war reaches new levels of intensity as it drags on, affecting civilian populations like never before. The concept of 'total war' becomes reality, with cities bombed into oblivion, resources stretched to their limits, and entire societies mobilized for the war effort. Strategic bombing campaigns against Germany and Japan begin to devastate industrial centers and civilian morale alike.

programme.title: Sacrifice: From D-Day to the Liberation of Paris
programme.desc: June 6th, 1944, 3 PM: Allies secure beaches; Hitler misjudges, expecting main landings in Pas-de-Calais. Hope rises as French populace anticipates liberation, despite slow Allied progress in Normandy. Paris liberated in August; war persists for another year, marking Normandy's profound sacrifice.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Gustav and Gothic Lines- Battle for Italy
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in Color, this documentary features Incredible air combat and ground attack attack action of a US Army Air Forces P-47 Thunderbolt group operating in Italy during 1944.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: An American Intelligence Officer faces off against a brutal Russian Colonel in a tense story about the 'kidnapping' of fifteen German war orphans. Sheltered by a brave Baroness, the children's fate is threatened when V Day Armistice places her home in the Russian zone. U.S. Captain Tom Ryan and Sergeant Steve Maycheck, decide to rescue the orphans and the Baroness, leading to a thrilling climax.

programme.title: The US Battle For Supremacy In The Pacific
programme.desc: In 1943 John Ford gave the great cinematographer Gregg Toland (Citizen Kane, The Grapes of Wrath) an opportunity to direct his first film. A veritable epic, framed by a debate between Walter Huston's Uncle Sam and Harry Davenport's Mr. C on the true nature of the Pacific paradise, Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: The Big Battles
programme.desc: The final chapter in the Pacific with the allies eventually wresting control from the Japanese and the bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
programme.sub-title: The Battle of the Pacific: The Setting Sun

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: This episode explores the battles between the Allies and Germans near the Arctic Circle, and the convoys battling past German-occupied Norway to Russia.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This chapter presents the events that led to America's entry into World War II after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. It also shows the early setbacks and losses suffered by the Allies in the Pacific Theater, such as the fall of Wake Island, Guam, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Malaya, and Indonesia.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.desc: Story of America's winter soldier throughout the history of the country from valley forge to the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: The Third Reich in Color
programme.desc: From 1937, colour films also document life in Hitler's Germany. Eva Braun and Hitler's pilot Hans Baur are among the first amateur filmmakers to expose the new celluloid. This creates unique images of the dictator's public appearances and his private life on Obersalzberg. Scanned in high-resolution HD, the footage of Hitler and his entourage unfolds a particularly realistic effect.

programme.title: Battle for Cassino
programme.desc: The Battle For Monte Cassino marked one of the longest and bloodiest engagements of the Italian campaign during World War II. For 9 months, the Allies struggled to take the Gustav Line and the abbey of Monte Cassino. In May 1944, the Gustav Line finally collapsed, with the Second Polish Corps succeeding in capturing the abbey. The Allies had paid a big price, but now the road to Rome was open.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. The stories of a father and son, a young relationship, cops and criminals, officials and their electorate coalesce into a mosaic of faces, places, and events. 45365 is a portrait of a city and its people. Directed by Turner Ross and Bill Ross IV.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.
